build_bmg_graph_from_builder: build a GeneratedGraph from a BMGraphBuilder by calling to_bmg_graph with the builder instance
generate_graph_with_optimizations: generate a BMG graph from a builder while skipping specific optimizations via skip_optimizations set
add_constant_to_graph: add a typed constant node to the graph using GeneratedGraph _add_constant supporting scalar and matrix types
add_distribution_to_graph: add a distribution node to the graph using GeneratedGraph _add_distribution with its type and inputs
reshape_tensor_for_bmg: reshape and transpose a torch tensor from row-major to column-major format using the _reshape helper
